[AWS Bedrock (Claude 3, Titan), MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, LangChain]

[Databricks (Data Intelligence Platform, Agent Bricks, AI/BI Genie)]
deployments_detail.value: $157M+ projected net new value over 5 years; $14M efficiency gains; 1,000 active users; 20% org adoption; 80+ live collaborations

[Microsoft (Azure, Forward Deployed Engineering / AI Acceleration Studio)]
